subject: HealthBridge — recap + schedule technical demo and attendee roster
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@healthbridge.ai>, Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & demo planning — HealthBridge

Hi Alex & Sarah,

Thanks again for the call today — super helpful to hear the platform goals and how inference cost/latency are showing up in your roadmap. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Recap (brief):
- Primary use case: near-real-time clinical summarization for telehealth visits (average seq len ~1.5k tokens).
- Key constraints: PHI in transit, on-prem/VPC deployment preferred for initial pilots, throughput target ~1200 reqs/min with p95 latency <350ms.
- Success metric for pilot: parity with current latency, 30% lower per-token cost, and audit logs for every request.

Suggested next step: 60-min technical deep dive/demo where our infra/engineers walk through: serving topology, routing/fallback policies, and a short perf run on a representative sample.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 1, 10:00–11:00 AM PDT
- Wed Aug 2, 2:00–3:00 PM PDT

Please confirm which works for you and who from your side will attend (we find 3–5 org-level attendees keeps the session focused). Also let us know if you prefer Google Meet or Zoom — we can accommodate either.

From our side we’ll bring: Neha (security/compliance), Karthik (serving/runtime), and myself for product and pilot scoping. I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan and a short security summary for pre-read.

Attachments: HealthBridge-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan, stub), redwood-security-summary.pdf (2-page security bulleted summary)

Thanks — look forward to locking a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
